design.sampling: DOI-clustered: whole papers are drawn until k rows are covered
design.gate: k=50 linear R2 >= 0 for >= 3/5 metals on the ligand-disjoint split
design.kill: k=100 R2 < 0 for >= 4/5 metals on the ligand-disjoint split
design.amendment_note: The original EXT-3 gate was 'k=50 recovers >=60% of the level gap'. EXT-1 measured the level gap at 5-10% of squared error, which makes that gate degenerate (a small denominator). The gate was rewritten to the deployment question before this script was first run.

caveats: Ceiling is rho^2 computed in-sample on the full test cohort; k-shot numbers are out-of-sample on the non-calibration rows, so k-shot cannot reach the ceiling even at large k. mean_frac_of_ceiling is therefore an upper-bound comparison, not a ratio that should approach 1.
On metal_out_ligand_disjoint the ceiling is 0.002-0.131, so R2 >= 0 is a weak absolute bar; it is nevertheless the deployment bar, because R2 < 0 means worse than predicting the metal's mean.
DOI-clustered sampling means the realised k exceeds the nominal k by up to one paper's row count.
